name: 🥞 Pancake PB&J Stack
tagline: Make a weekend batch of fluffy pancakes, then it's a 2-minute PB&J breakfast all week.

items.name: Butter, melted, plus more for the pan

steps.text: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a big bowl.
In another bowl whisk milk, eggs, melted butter and vanilla.
Pour wet into dry and stir just until combined. Lumps are good. Rest 5 minutes.
Heat a griddle or skillet over medium with a little butter. Pour ¼ cup per pancake.
Flip when bubbles pop and the edges look dry, about 2 minutes; cook 1 minute more.
Cool on a rack, then freeze in a bag with parchment between them.
Weekday: toast or microwave 2 pancakes 45 seconds. Spread PB on one, grape on the other, stack, add banana.

kid_jobs.job: Measure and whisk the dry ingredients
Bag the cooled pancakes for the freezer
Build your own PB&J stack on school mornings

chef_tip: Stop stirring while the batter is still lumpy. Over-mixing makes pancakes tough; lumps make them fluffy.
make_ahead: That's the whole point: pancakes freeze up to 2 months. Reheat in the toaster.
leftovers: Frozen pancakes are lunch-box friendly too.
swaps: Bonne Maman preserves or strawberry jam
serve_with: Fruit and a glass of milk
heads_up: Melt the butter first so it can cool a bit.
